| description = Sir Lucan was formerly a paladin of the [[Knights of Truth]] until he took over half the city with a band of mercenaries, the [[Freeport Militia]], while the paladins were away on a campaign. The paladins stripped him of his holy powers and continue to oppose his secular rule. The city remains divided in a cold war.

Reanimates immediately as the skeletal [[Sir Lucan D`Lere]] upon death. [[Brother Jentry]] has a unique aggro link with Sir Lucan. The living Sir Lucan hits harder and is more magic resistant than his undead form. Summoning a pet while in Lucan's room will sometimes cause the pet to spawn in the floor above, causing a train of guards.
